description: This is a Java integration test class for the ReadingGoalController in a Spring Boot application. It sets up mocked login, tests various API endpoints related to reading goals such as retrieval, creation, and deletion using MockMvc.

classes.name: ReadingGoalControllerIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration tests for the ReadingGoalController API endpoints, including login setup and various goal operations.

methods.name: canLoginWithTestUser
methods.description: Initial setup method that logs in a test user before each test, stores the JWT token for authentication.

methods.name: getPreviousReadingGoals_returnHttpStatus_whenReadingGoalExists
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of previous reading goals, expects HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: addBooksReadingGoal_returnBadRequestHttpStatus_whenWrongTargetInput
methods.description: Tests adding a book reading goal with invalid input, expects HTTP 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: addPagesReadingGoal_returnBadRequestHttpStatus_whenWrongTargetInput
methods.description: Tests adding a pages reading goal with invalid input, expects HTTP 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: addBooksReadingGoal_returnIsOkRequestHttpStatus_whenCorrectTargetInput
methods.description: Tests adding a valid book reading goal, expects HTTP 201 Created.

methods.name: addPagesReadingGoal_returnIsOkRequestHttpStatus_whenCorrectTargetInput
methods.description: Tests adding a valid pages reading goal, expects HTTP 201 Created.

methods.name: deleteReadingGoal_returnIsOkRequestHttpStatus_whenRequestIsDone
methods.description: Tests deleting reading goals, expects HTTP 204 No Content.
